# Swagat Public School, Lakhna (SPS Lakhna)

> Swagat Public School (also written SPS Lakhna) is a co-educational, English-medium school following the CBSE pattern in Purna Basti, Lakhna, Komna block, Nuapada district, Odisha 766105, India. It was established in 2024 by Mr. Narendra Nag and is directed by Mrs. Reena Kumbhar. Classes run from Nursery to Class 5 today, and the school is permitted to teach from Nursery to Class 8. "Swagat" means "welcome", and the school's motto is "Where Every Child is Welcome".

## Key facts
- **Name:** Swagat Public School
- **Also known as:** SPS Lakhna, Swagat Public School Lakhna, Swagat Public School Nuapada; the building's signboard reads "Swagat Play School" (same school)
- **Established:** 2024
- **Founder:** Mr. Narendra Nag
- **Director:** Mrs. Reena Kumbhar
- **Type:** Co-educational, English medium, CBSE-pattern curriculum
- **Classes running now:** Nursery, LKG, UKG and Class 1 to Class 5
- **Permitted classes:** Nursery to Class 8
- **Address:** Purna Basti, Lakhna, Block Komna, Dist. Nuapada, Odisha 766105, India
- **Areas served:** Lakhna and nearby parts of Nuapada district, including Nuapada, Khariar Road, Komna and Khariar

## Academic programs
- **Early Years (Nursery, LKG, UKG):** Ages 3 to 6. Play-based learning, first phonics and numbers, art and social skills. Classes finish at 12:00 PM.
- **Primary (Class 1 to 5):** Ages 6 to 11. English-medium lessons on the CBSE pattern. The school is permitted to add Classes 6 to 8.
- **Entrance coaching (Class 4 and 5):** Special, challenging coaching for the entrance tests of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Model School (Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya), Sainik School and similar schools.
- **Activities:** Yoga and meditation, dance, song and music, GK quiz, essay writing, drawing and art.

## Events and school life
Children's Day (14 Nov 2026), Gandhi Jayanti and Swachhata Abhiyan, yoga and drawing classes, Ganesh Puja (14 Sep 2026), Nutrition Month healthy-food activity (Sep 2026), Janmashtami procession (3 Sep 2026), Independence Day 2026 (fancy dress, speeches, certificates; reported in a local Odia newspaper), National Deworming Day (10 Aug 2026), a plantation programme, and Independence Day 2024 prabhat pheri through Lakhna. Photos: https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in/gallery

## Admissions
Admissions are open for Nursery to Class 5. Parents fill in the application form at https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in/admissions (it is sent to the school office on WhatsApp), visit the school to meet the teachers, and then receive confirmation of enrolment. Nursery is for ages 3 to 4, LKG 4 to 5, UKG 5 to 6, Class 1 to 5 from about 6 to 11.
